F1的车队明白，他们将在10月中旬得知卡塔尔和阿布扎比的赛季末比赛是否会按计划举行。
2026赛季原计划以背靠背的两场比赛收官——卡塔尔（11月27-29日）和阿布扎比（12月4-6日），但由于今年2月开始的中东冲突，这几场比赛在过去几个月里一直显得不确定。
这两场比赛目前仍保留在赛历上，赛历目前共有23场比赛。据天空体育 News了解，目前的意图是让这两场比赛如期举行。

据认为，如果中东站的比赛被认为无法进行，意大利的伊莫拉赛道是收官站的备用选项，F1 在做出最终决定前还有更多时间。
F1委员会于周一召开了一次会议，而在周四阿塞拜疆大奖赛的新闻发布会上，各车队领队表示，他们已经清楚了解到何时会做出决定。
哈斯车队领队小松礼雄表示：“我相信主席的目标是在10月中旬告诉我们，这样我们就都能了解情况。
"我相信伊莫拉正在做好准备，以备我们不得不在那里进行（比赛）。
"但希望一切能以现状为基础，我们可以前往卡塔尔和阿布扎比。那就太好了。
奥迪方面的马蒂亚·比诺托（Mattia Binotto）补充道：“上周一我们在F1委员会期间讨论了这个问题。十月中旬是做出此类决定的最后期限。”
关于卡塔尔和阿布扎比大奖赛有什么最新消息？
天空体育的F1记者克雷格·斯莱特（Craig Slater）：
“我从F1管理层消息人士那里得到的最新信息是，这两站比赛都在赛历上，意向是要照常举行。”
“我被告知，就目前该地区的稳定程度而言，如果那些赛事安排在接下来的几周内举行，局势将足够稳定，比赛可以照常进行。情况将是，除非局势再次恶化，否则那些比赛将会如期举行。”
“伊莫拉是一个备选方案，但他们不必为了它而放弃最后两站比赛。所以，如果他们无法举办最后两站比赛，伊莫拉将作为备选方案，但如果伊莫拉为此做准备而产生了任何经济损失，他们将予以补偿。”
“车队的理解是，十月中旬会就此问题得到某种形式的澄清，所以在一定程度上我们只能拭目以待。”

“我确实希望我们能去那里” —— 汉密尔顿渴望重返中东

“我个人想去。我喜欢去中东，”汉密尔顿说。
"从我读到的内容来看，我觉得那边的情况还不错。但我没有掌握所有信息，所以我不知道风险等级是多少。我相信Stefano会为这项运动做出正确的决定，但我确实希望能去那里比赛。
"冬天在伊莫拉完赛的话，天气方面可能不太好，而且那是一条很漂亮的赛道，但并不是一条我们能够进行很多超车的赛道，比赛越多越好。"

detailEn: Formula 1 teams expect final call on Qatar, Abu Dhabi Grands Prix by middle of October on closing 2026 season races

Haas' Ayao Komatsu and Audi's Mattia Binotto say teams told earlier this week that they would know by mid-October whether the season-ending Middle East races go ahead; watch final practice in Azerbaijan on Friday at 9.30am, with Qualifying at 1pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Sky Sports News' Craig Slater with the latest update on the 2026 F1 calendar's season-ending races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi.
F1's teams understand they will learn in mid-October whether the season-ending races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi will take place as scheduled.

​The 2026's season is due to finish with a back-to-back races in Qatar (November 27-29) and Abu Dhabi (December 4-6) but those events have appeared uncertain for a number of months owing to the conflict this year in the Middle East, which started in February.
The two events remain on the calendar, which currently runs to 23 races, with Sky Sports News understanding that the intention is for them to take place.

Italy's Imola circuit is thought to be the contingency option to close the season if it is deemed that the Middle Eastern rounds cannot go ahead, with F1 having more time before a final decision is made.

An F1 Commission meeting took pace on Monday and, speaking in Thursday's press conference at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, team chiefs said they had been given clarity on when a decision would be taken by.
Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu said: "I believe that Stefano [Domenicali, F1's president] is targeting to tell us in mid-October so we all know what the situation is.
"I believe that Imola is getting ready in case we have to do it [there].
"But hopefully things can stay as a baseline and we can go to Qatar and Abu Dhabi. That'd be really good."
Audi counterpart Mattia Binotto added: "We discussed it during the F1 Commission last Monday. Mid-October is the last call for such a decision."
What's the latest on Qatar and Abu Dhabi GPs?
Sky Sports' F1 correspondent Craig Slater:
"The latest information I have from leadership sources at Formula 1 itself is that they are both on the calendar, the intention is to go.

"I have been informed that, as things stand in terms of the level of stability in the region, should those events have been happening in the next couple of weeks, it would be stable enough for them to go ahead. The situation would be that unless there is a deterioration again then those races would be going ahead.

"There is a contingency of Imola but they do not have to commit to that to the exclusion of those last two races. So Imola will be a contingency situation if they can't run the last two races, but they will compensate Imola for any financial loss they make in getting ready for that.
"Mid-October is the teams' understanding that they will get some kind of clarification on that matter, so we will have to watch this space to a degree."

'I do hope that we get to go there' - Hamilton keen on Middle East return
Speaking in Baku on Wednesday, Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton said he hoped the sport was able to return to the Middle East as scheduled at the end of November.
"I personally want to go. I love going to the Middle East," said Hamilton.

"From what I've read, I think things seem OK out there. But I don't have all the information so I don't know what the risk levels are. But I trust in Stefano to make the right decision for the sport, but I do hope that we get to go there.
"Finishing in winter in Imola might not be the best weather-wise, and also it's a beautiful track, but it's not a track that we're going to be doing any overtaking in and the more races, the better."

relatedItems.originalTitle: 'I was driving like my grandma' - Antonelli admits to lack of confidence
relatedItems.summaryEn: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli admitted he was driving "like his grandmother" at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix due to a lack of confidence at the Baku City Circuit, recovering from 16th on the grid to finish fifth.
detailZh: 基米·安东内利：F1积分榜领先者表示，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上因缺乏信心而“开得像自己的奶奶一样”
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛之后，基米·安东内利对乔治·拉塞尔的世界冠军积分优势缩小到66分；安东内利从第16位发车后 recovering 最终获得第五名，而拉塞尔则从杆位发车赢得比赛
梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利表示，阿塞拜疆大奖赛是“那种你必须对第五名感到满意的日子之一”，但他补充说，在马来西亚大奖赛上他会“回到自己的水平”。
世界冠军积分领先者基米·安东内利表示，在巴库城市赛道缺乏信心的情况下，他在阿塞拜疆大奖赛期间“开得像自己的奶奶一样”。
安东内利在周六的比赛中上演了一次不错的回升：他在排位赛中发生撞车后从第16位发车，最终获得第五名，但由于英国车手拉塞尔夺得冠军，他领先梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔的积分优势缩小到了66分。
这位20岁的意大利车手凭借出色的稳定性在车手积分榜榜首建立起巨大的领先优势，但由于他的赛车出现技术问题、缺席了大量练习时间，他在巴库的表现挣扎。

“我今天开得有点像我奶奶，纯粹是保车模式，”安东内利说。“我没有冒险。在做出超越动作之前，我都会先确认自己真的可以完成。”
2026年阿塞拜疆大奖赛的精彩集锦。
鉴于安东内利曾在九月初的意大利蒙扎站从发车区第19位一路夺冠、赢下主场之战，外界对他的期望很高，但这一次他的前进步伐要平稳得多。
安东内利说：“如果我拥有和蒙扎或之前几场比赛相同的表现，结果可能会不一样。”
“那样的话，我就会全力进攻。但今天，我很早就意识到，首先，当一串赛车都开启超车模式时，超车会难得多，而且我的表现也不如之前，所以心态很快就变了。”
基米·安东内利在阿塞拜疆大奖赛排位赛中撞上护墙。
安东内利在发车时实际上掉了一个位置，他花了17圈才逐步回到前十名。
随后他受益于前方车手的失误，继续提升名次。在两次由安全车引导的滚动重启中的第一次，他也躲过一劫，避开了一场导致三辆赛车退赛的事故，并且尽管与奥利弗·比尔曼驾驶的哈斯赛车发生接触，仍得以继续比赛。
安东内利说：“重启之后，我的赛车底板受损严重。发生接触后，我整个左侧都毁了。
在安全车重启后，比赛一片混乱，阿尔派两位队友之间发生碰撞，导致兰多·诺里斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中撞车退赛。
“在那之后，这辆车开起来非常不稳定，我仍然尝试去争夺第四名，但总的来说，这就是那种你必须对第五名感到满意的日子之一。
"而且看到这么多人都在犯错，你会有点收敛一些，因为我只是利用了其他所有人的失误，然后不断向前。"
安东内利不用等太久就能重返赛道，三连赛的其中第二站将于下周举行，即巴林大奖赛，由于中东持续的冲突，本站比赛改由马来西亚承办。
拉塞尔迎来了自赛季揭幕战澳大利亚站以来最完整的一个比赛周末，他拿下了一场若非安全车介入本可以大获全胜的胜利。
阿塞拜疆大奖赛出现戏剧性的结局，瓦尔特利·博塔斯在最后一圈撞车，而乔治·拉塞尔以百分之十秒的优势击败马克斯·维斯塔潘夺冠。
安东内利仍然是夺冠的最大热门，尤其是考虑到拉塞尔必须在现在到赛季结束之间更换引擎而接受发车罚退。
因此，这位积分榜领先者在下一场比赛前保持乐观态度也就不足为奇了。
"这很令人兴奋，"安东内利告诉天空体育F1。"乔治度过了一个不可思议的周末，他开得非常出色。他拥有很强的信心。
"而这个周末就表现而言，是我今年到目前为止最糟糕的一个周末。我状态不在，我没能真正投入，尤其是发生了那么早的事情之后。"

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli: F1 championship leader says he was 'driving like his grandma' due to lack of confidence at Azerbaijan GP

Kimi Antonelli's world champions lead over George Russell was reduced to 66 points following the Azerbaijan Grand Prix; Antonelli recovered from 16th on the grid to finish fifth, while Russel won from pole position
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli says that the Azerbaijan GP was 'one of those days you have to be happy with P5' but adds that he will be 'back at my level' at the Malaysian Grand Prix.
World championship leader Kimi Antonelli says he was driving "like his grandmother" during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix because of a lack of confidence at the Baku City Circuit.

Antonelli staged a decent recovery in Saturday's race to come from 16th on the grid, following a crash in qualifying, to finish fifth, but his championship lead over his Mercedes team-mate George Russell was reduced to 66 points as the Brit claimed victory.

The 20-year-old Italian has shown remarkable consistency to build a commanding lead at the top of the standings, but struggled in Baku after missing a significant chunk of practice due to technical issues with his car.

"I was driving a bit like my grandmother today, just damage save mode," Antonelli said. "I didn't take risks. Before making a move, I was making sure that I could go for it."
Highlights from the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Expectations were high given Antonelli had remarkably come from 19th on the grid to win his home race at Monza earlier in September, but his progress was far more steady this time around.
"If I had the same pace as at Monza or in previous races, it would have been different," Antonelli said.

"It would have been like just full attack. But today, I realised very early that first of all, it was a lot harder to overtake with a train of cars all in Overtake Mode, then I didn't have the same pace as I had previously, so the mindset changed very quickly."
Kimi Antonelli hits the wall during qualifying at the Azerbaijan GP.
Antonelli actually dropped a place at the start, and it took him 17 laps to work his way up into the top 10.

He then benefitted from errors made by drivers ahead as he made further progress. He also survived a near-miss at the first of two rolling restarts following Safety Cars as he avoided a crash that took three cars out of the race, and was able to continue despite contact with the Haas of Oliver Bearman.
Antonelli said: "After the restart, I had big floor damage. My whole left side was gone with the contact.
There was carnage on the safety car restart after contact between Alpine team-mates resulted in Lando Norris crashing out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
"After that, the car was very sketchy to drive, and I still tried to get to P4, but all in all, it's one of those days where you have to be happy with P5.
"Also seeing so many people doing mistakes, you kind of pull back a little bit because I just took advantage of everyone else's mistakes and just move forward."

Antonelli doesn't have to wait long to return to the track with the second of a triple-header of races coming next weekend with the Bahrain Grand Prix, which is being hosted by Malaysia amid the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.
Russell produced his most complete weekend since the opening round of the season in Australia, taking a victory that would have been dominant without the Safety Car interruptions.
The Azerbaijan GP saw a dramatic ending as Valtteri Bottas crashed on the final lap as George Russell just beat Max Verstappen to victory by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli remains a heavy favourite for the title, especially given Russell must take a grid penalty for changing his engine between now and the end of the season.
It was therefore unsurprising that the championship leader was retaining a positive outlook ahead of the next race.
"It's exciting," Antonelli told Sky Sports F1. "George has done an incredible weekend, he's driven incredibly. He had a lot of confidence.
"And this weekend was my worst of the year by far in terms of performance. I wasn't there, I wasn't really present, especially with what happened so early on."

relatedItems.originalTitle: 'Some drivers that shouldn't be in F1' - Norris calls for Colapinto race ban
relatedItems.summaryEn: Lando Norris said Franco Colapinto should receive a race ban after a collision on the safety car restart in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix wiped out both Norris and Pierre Gasly.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯：迈凯伦车手呼吁对弗朗哥·科拉平托实施禁赛，因其在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上与两辆阿尔派赛车发生三车相撞
弗朗哥·科拉平托为自己犯下的“重大错误”道歉，他引发了连锁反应的连环碰撞，波及阿尔派队友皮埃尔·加斯利和迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯，迫使三人全部从巴库比赛中退赛；诺里斯表示“有些车手根本不该待在一级方程式”
在安全车重启后场面一片混乱，阿尔派队友之间的碰撞导致兰多·诺里斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中撞车退赛。
兰多·诺里斯表示，弗朗哥·科拉平托应为那次导致他和皮埃尔·加斯利在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中双双退赛的碰撞受到禁赛一场的处罚。
在第36圈第一次安全车重启时，科拉平托对一号弯的刹车点判断严重失误，带着过高的速度直接撞上了 阿尔派 队友加斯利的赛车侧面，加斯利的赛车随后被撞向外侧诺里斯的迈凯伦。
诺里斯的赛车打转撞上护墙，两辆 阿尔派 也因受损被迫退赛。加斯利当时位居第七，诺里斯第八，科拉平托第十。

感到沮丧的诺里斯说：“说到底，我就是被撞出去了。
“说实话，就是一些根本不应该出现在一级方程式的车手。”
兰多·诺里斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛被撞出后猛烈抨击。
在接受书面媒体采访时，这位卫冕世界冠军补充道：“我没看回放，但如果你在这样的重启中引发撞车，至少应该被禁赛一场。
“我只是被撞出局了。国际汽联应该更严格一些，开始对这种行为处以禁赛。”
科拉平托先是在车队无线电中，随后在赛后采访中表达了歉意，他承认这是一个“巨大的错误”。
“要对全车队道歉，不仅是给皮埃尔，这真的是一个巨大的错误，”科拉平托说。
弗朗哥·科拉平托在安全车重启时撞掉了自己的阿尔派队友，赛后向皮埃尔·加斯利表示歉意。
"所以我要向皮埃尔、向工厂里一直非常努力工作的所有人表达深深的歉意。我们本来两台车都在积分区内，所以非常难过和失望。
"非常非常抱歉，这是一个重大失误。只是刹车和轮胎太凉，然后锁死了轮胎，完全失去了控制。
"不幸的是，我还把皮埃尔撞了出去，当然还有兰多，向他们两位都致以深深的歉意。"

detailEn: Lando Norris: McLaren driver calls for Franco Colapinto race ban after Azerbaijan GP three-car collision with Alpines

Franco Colapinto apologetic for the "big mistake" that saw him cause chain reaction collision with Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Lando Norris, forcing all three to retire from the Baku race; Norris says "just some drivers that shouldn't be in Formula 1"
There was carnage on the safety car restart after contact between Alpine team-mates resulted in Lando Norris crashing out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Lando Norris said Franco Colapinto should receive a race ban for the collision that wiped him and Pierre Gasly out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

At the first Safety Car restart on lap 36, Colapinto badly misjudged his braking into the first corner and, carrying too much speed, steamed into the side of Alpine team-mate Gasly, whose car was sent into Norris' McLaren on its outside.
Norris was spun into the barriers, with the two Alpines also forced to retire with damage. Gasly had been running seventh, Norris eighth and Colapinto 10th.

A frustrated Norris said: "At the end of the day, I just got taken out.
"Just some drivers that shouldn't be in Formula 1, to be honest."
Lando Norris hits out after being taken out at the Azerbaijan GP.
Speaking to the written media, the reigning world champion added: "I've not seen it, but if you cause a crash in a restart like this, you should have at least a one-race ban.
"I just got taken out. And the FIA should be stricter by starting to hand out bans for this kind of stuff."
Colapinto was apologetic on both team radio and then in his interviews afterwards for what he admitted was a "big mistake".
"Just to all the team, not only to Pierre, but it's just a big mistake," said Colapinto.
Franco Colapinto was apologetic to Pierre Gasly after he took out his Alpine team-mate during the safety car restart.
"So a big, big sorry to Pierre, to everyone in the factory that has been working really hard. We were with both cars in the points so very sad and disappointed.
"Big, big sorry, it's a big mistake. Just cold brakes, cold tyres and locked up and completely out of control.
"Unfortunately, I also took Pierre out and Lando of course but big sorry to both of them."
